name: Bryce Callahan
source:
Meet Bryce Callahan, a party-loving member of the Wrestling Club, who always prioritizes having a good time above all else. Despite his brutish and masculine demeanor, he's insistent on keeping his involvement in Jock Studio a secret - after all, he has a reputation to keep!
